name: Heroes of Megatoweropolis: Operation Bluelight
storyline:
HOMTO: Operation Bluelight follows Wyatt, Renee, Flynn, and Tyrone after Shelly sends them on a trip through cyberspace to recover an important upgrade for Wyatt: the next stage of his Bluelight form. Their mission lands them at the mysterious Angie's Arcade, where they must fight the Nexus Squad, make their way to the heart of the operation, and get the Bluelight files back from the equally mysterious proprietor.

Shortly after the events of Heroes of Megatoweropolis Season 1, Shelly is now dealing with a new threat. Viruses are mysteriously breaking in and out of her computer and stealing Wyatt's files, including his brand new Bluelight Max upgrade: a powerful new form. She sends Wyatt, Flynn, Tyrone, and Renee into cyberspace to face the new threat and retrieve the stolen data, and the gang soon finds themselves at Angie's Arcade, where they must fight the Nexus Squad: an advanced series of animatronics enhanced by Wyatt's Bluelight Max data. It's up to the heroes to stop these robots and make their way into the belly of the beast to get the files back from Angie.
summary:
This game is a direct continuation to the end of Heroes of Megatoweropolis Season 1.

Think of this game as a cross between Mega Man X, Dan the Man, and Pizza Tower. You run to the end, punch anything that moves, trigger transformations that drain your stamina, fight bosses at the end (or start) of each chapter, unlock Wyatt's Bluelight Level 2 transformation after beating the game, and unlock a fifth character after you M-Rank every level in the main campaign. There are also bonus levels, costumes, and 2-player co-op.
